Commentary.Commentary: That's it from today's two games. On 29th it is again a double-header where in first up New Zealand women take on Bangladesh Women. It is followed by India Women's vs Sri Lanka women's. Till then take care and cheers!

Heather Knight, England skipper says that there are still a lot of areas where they can improve. Also praises Natalie Sciver for her performance. Further mentions that they are happy with their bowling and fielding. Mentions that they want to score big and play positive cricket as their main target is to qualify for the semi finals.

Javeria Khan comes for the interview in place of the regular skipper Bismah Maroof. She says that  their skipper Bismah Maroof  played up front and got hit on the thumb. Further says that more than the bowling their fielding let them down. Further adds onto say that they could not execute their plans too and that cost them the game. Further says that they will grow as a unit and work on the flaws. Mentions that the pitch was good to bat but they failed to capitalize on it. Also says that poor shot selection let them down.

PLAYER OF THE MATCH, Heather Knight says that she will be disappointed to leave Canberra. Further says that she thought that one of the spinners would get the player of the match. Mentions that she enjoys batting up the order and loves to lay a platform for the team. Also says that she just thinks of staying till the end.

England on the other hand, bowled well. They kept it nice and tight, attacked the stumps and managed to pick wickets when needed. Shrubsole and Glenn were the pick as the two took three each. Brunt and Eccleston also finished with two. Overall, a complete performance by England.

A very convincing win for England! Pakistan just looked off color tonight. They were poor with the ball which saw England end with an above par total and in the chase they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Their top order failed to make an impact. Just the one batter managed to cross the 20-run mark, Riaz, who was the top scorer, however, the task for her was a little too much. Her innings though gave some respectability to the Pakistan total.
